items.name: Elke Donker Wolk
items.overview: When Johan Joubert joins a support group for the bereaved, he meets André, whose wife has been lying in a hospital coma for two years with severe brain damage. Their friendship appears coincidental, but is actually pre-planned. One of the two men has a hidden agenda, while the other harbors a dark secret of his own. Together, they must learn to process devastating loss.

items.name: The Circle
items.overview: This social experiment brings together everyday players and celebrities to compete side by side in a game of popularity where identity is ever-changing, and anyone can be anyone. Filmed in real time, the series gives viewers exclusive access as twists and player ratings unfold, with audience votes shaping the game. This fresh take supercharges the original's signature mix of strategy and deception into an addictive experience built for today's always-on audience.

items.name: Queen
items.overview: Love betrayed Neeti and an assault shattered her world. As fate leads her into a powerful political family, can she navigate this challenging new world?

items.name: The Devil's Plan B
items.overview: Contestants from "The Devil's Plan: Dead Again" reunite to reveal their true feelings, dissect fan theories and relive the intense competition.

items.name: Mark of a Murderer
items.overview: Former journalist, now MP Colleen Egan investigates the lives of two men convicted of murder.

items.name: In Your Corner
items.overview: Moon Do-hyeok and Yoon Si-woo are childhood neighborhood friends who have known each other since they were young. Living their separate daily lives as a boxing gym trainer and a content marketer, the two are close enough to come and go from each other's homes and share even the smallest details of their lives. As they navigate unexpected incidents and crises big and small while working toward their own goals, they gradually begin to see each other—whom they had always taken for granted—in a special new light. A subtle shift begins within their familiar friendship. Will the two of them be able to cross the line from friends to lovers and start a new romance?

items.name: 177 Giorni. Il rapimento di Farouk
items.overview: The story of the kidnapping of young Farouk Kassam, which took place on the Costa Smeralda on January 15, 1992. A foreign family, long-established on the island—a father, a mother, and two children—lived what might have seemed like a paradise on earth, until one day, violence erupted, changing their lives forever. Seven-year-old Farouk was abducted from his home by a group of criminals, right before the horrified and helpless eyes of his parents and little sister. Thus began a nightmare that would last 177 days, holding all of Italy in suspense—a historic event that would even go so far as to put the State itself under immense strain. Faced with a harrowing ordeal like the kidnapping of a child, the individuals involved discovered within themselves resources, limitations, emotions, and instincts they never knew they possessed—while their closest bonds and firmest certainties were put to the ultimate test.

items.name: Honesty House
items.overview: A group of single men and women live together in a paradisiacal setting, but with one absolute, unbreakable rule: they must always tell the truth. The participants—including couples who have chosen to join the experiment—are subjected to periodic questioning while connected to a lie-detection system. The polygraph probes critical topics, such as their true intentions, physical attraction toward other contestants, and the most deeply hidden secrets of their lives.

items.name: Crime and Punishment in America
items.overview: The story of criminal justice in America from the colonial era to today, and how Americans have wrestled with the problem of crime, the purpose of punishment and the meaning of justice for more than 250 years.

items.name: Still a Family
items.overview: In 2008, a Jiaodong Peninsula family’s demolition windfall uncovers decades of dysfunction. Patriach Sai Duoxi controls his five children—from the spineless eldest to the adopted youngest—until cancer shakes his authority. As they confront moral bonds, the family realizes love thrives on equality, not patriarchal power.

items.name: The Countess of Monte Cristo
items.overview: 1815. When her fiancé is wrongfully imprisoned and her rescue attempt ends in tragedy, Mercédès vows revenge against those who destroyed her life.

items.name: Space Jam: Beyond the Jam
items.overview: Get ready to go Beyond the Jam with the upcoming six-part mini-doc featuring Michael Jordan, Aleali May, Anthony Anderson, Azzi Fudd, DJ Khaled, Jayson Tatum, Kam Patterson, Nigel Sylvester, Russell Westbrook, Teyana Taylor, and many more!

items.name: GOLDEN
items.overview: Young Tanzanian actor Golden battles personal struggles and industry challenges to achieve international stardom.

items.name: Blossom in Darkness
items.overview: Qi Fengyin, a feared demon lord blamed for all evil, encounters Ya Mao, a girl whose flesh is coveted for its extraordinary powers. Forced into a bond, the two clash yet gradually become each other's salvation. Together, they unravel six bizarre mysteries involving deadly curses, demons, resurrection, and forbidden love. As they expose a hidden conspiracy, they clear their names, free the world from its shackles, and give lovers a chance to stay together.

items.name: Drunken Monkey
items.overview: The series follows a character named Tofigh (played by Siamak Ansari), who is given the mission to welcome Jackie Chan to Iran. However, things do not go as planned, and his mission turns into an exciting, strange, and hilarious adventure filled with unexpected events and humorous situations. Alongside Farshad (played by Hadi Kazemi) and other characters, Tofigh gets tangled up in a series of unpredictable comedic chaos.

items.overview: Baby pumpkin stories together

items.name: Dead children also need to be tucked in
items.overview: Mette had to go home from the hospital with an empty cradle. Now she turns her own deep grief into caring for other parents who lose their child. She helps them with nut christening dresses and chilist posts, sewn by donated wedding dresses so they can take a beautiful and dignified farewell.

items.name: Wallis Simpson
items.overview: The untold story of what happened to the Duchess of Windsor after Edward VIII's death.

items.name: Koba LaD : Demain j'arrête
items.overview: Through archive footage and accounts from people close to him, this documentary series follows French rapper Koba LaD from his beginnings in Évry to his breakthrough in music. It explores the contrasts between his public success, his personal life and the legal troubles that led to his imprisonment.

items.name: Alan's Universe
items.overview: Alan and his friends navigate a world of friendship, romance, rivalry, and extraordinary adventures. From high school bullies and secret pop star identities to supernatural encounters and unexpected love stories, every episode transports the group into a new universe where they discover that love and friendship can overcome even the wildest challenges.

items.name: จังหวะหัวใจกลายเป็นเธอ
items.original_name: จังหวะหัวใจกลายเป็นเธอ
items.overview: It started as a dream not just as an debuted idol. But when we dance together, my heart beats because of you.

items.name: Aftertaste
items.original_name: この味もまたいつか恋しくなる
items.overview: Based on essays by the popular author Moegara, here are eight poignant stories—each inspired by a specific flavor—in which people and moments from the past come back to life.

items.name: The White House Is Fake
items.overview: Nelson Conrad, a bright but eccentric teen from small-town, dreams of adventure and validation. After spotting a strange poster advertising a mysterious event, he's drawn into an underground conspiracy involving government cover-ups.

items.name: Enchanted
items.overview: In the quiet town of Iskra, where people don't even know they're in the neighborhood of otherworldly forces, two witch sisters live. They are twins, but very different. For the excellent student Zlata, fate is sealed — she will inherit from her mother the role of guardian of the border between the worlds of people and shadows. And Marya doesn't know who to be. She doesn't want to cram spells just like that, but dreams of living a full human life. But everything changes dramatically when Marya opens a portal to the World of shadows on Kalinov Bridge out of a desire to win an argument from the arrogant Sonya, the adopted daughter of the mayor of the city. In an attempt to fix what happened, Zlata dies, and now Marya has 9 days to find living water and save her sister.

items.name: Eurovision Song Contest Asia
items.overview:
The world's most iconic music competition is coming to Asia, and it's about to get louder, bolder and bigger than ever.

From national selection shows across Asia to a live Grand Final in Bangkok, packed with lights, sound and unstoppable energy — this is where the region comes together.

items.name: Sword & Silence
items.overview: Six centuries of war have left the Three Kingdoms in turmoil. Facing powerful rivals, a small nation fights to unite a divided land.

items.name: Honey
items.overview: East Berlin, 1982. Marta, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois.

items.name: Dua Nyawa
items.overview: After discovering she is pregnant outside of marriage, young Farhana faces rejection from her family, social stigma, and an uncertain future. While Zafran struggles to accept responsibility, Farhana's loyal friend Fawwaz steps up to support her even at the cost of his own future—until Zafran returns to reclaim his role and complicates everything

items.name: Rewarding
items.overview: Caring for their clients - if not each other. Support workers Sinead and Francis muddle through as they clash, flirt and overshare.

items.name: Identity Crisis
items.overview: Half Egyptian. Half Palestinian. Raised in Dubai. Dentist on paper, comedian in practice. Mohamed Badr mines a lifetime of mixed signals and clashing expectations for laughs… and the occasional existential crisis

items.name: Sleeping With The Enemy
items.overview: At seventeen, Aruna Wirawan loses everything after being framed by the powerful Sastranegara family for a crime she did not commit. Eight years later, she returns with a new identity and marries Revan Sastranegara, planning to destroy his family from the inside. But her revenge begins to fall apart when she falls in love with Adrian, Revan's brother-in-law, leaving her torn between finishing her mission and following her heart.

items.name: Clangold
items.overview: A 100-kilogram gold coin called the Big Maple Leaf is stolen from Berlin's Bode Museum, leading investigators into the city's clan gang milieu in a cat-and-mouse pursuit of the perpetrators.

items.name: Stars and Vows: Anele & Buzza
items.overview: Follow media darling Anele Mdoda and her royal fiance Buzza James from pre-wedding celebrations and tense family moments to their long-awaited "I do."

items.name: Maniacs of the Truth
items.overview: This two-part documentary series explores Hungary’s most notorious and high-profile criminal cases following the fall of communism through the regular dinner gatherings of a unique group of friends - including retired detective Ernő Tóth and his former colleagues.

items.name: Far-Fetched
items.overview: After accidentally releasing her own chaotic canine creature into the world, a young woman named Rue joins a rock band of late-2000's misfits to fight for survival in a town where science is at odds with the horrific supernatural.

items.name: Shattered Legends
items.overview: A six-part hololive production x Critical Role Daggerheart mini-series set in Exandria's Shattered Teeth, led by Matthew Mercer.

items.name: Student of the Year: After Dark
items.original_name: Student of the Year: After Dark
items.overview: Student of the Year: After Dark reimagines the St. Teresa's campus as the setting of a murder mystery after the school's queen bee, Aayesha Malik, is found dead in a frozen lake. Refusing to believe it was an accident, her introverted twin sister Aditi goes undercover at the elite institution to investigate her death.

items.name: ROCK PAPER LANDMINE
items.overview: Glico, Daruma-san ga Koronda... A game everyone knows—transformed into the ultimate battle of wits!?

items.name: Faces Reborn
items.overview: A woman betrayed after donating facial skin to save her husband undergoes surgery to assume a new identity and take revenge on the family that destroyed her life.

items.name: Infamy
items.overview: A troubled lawyer becomes obsessed with solving a decades-old disappearance, forcing her to confront her childhood trauma and powerful forces determined to keep the truth buried.

items.name: Silent Night
items.overview: Follow the aftermath of a brutal Christmas Eve crime and its impact on a rural Polish community.

items.name: Murder in Galicia
items.overview: In Pazos, Irene is brutally attacked, and Civil Guard sergeant Elías suspects her husband Aniceto, racing against time to uncover the truth before it’s too late.

items.name: The Awakened
items.overview: A man awakens from suspended animation with memories of 1955 and reunites with his grandson, while a boxer begins recovering mysterious memories connected to secrets beneath the sea.

items.name: Nothing Happened
items.overview: A comedy-drama that explores the dynamics of long-term marriage, bourgeois life, the unraveling of relationships, personal crises, and decision-making processes in modern life.

items.name: 暗恋对象的弟弟要追我
items.original_name: 暗恋对象的弟弟要追我

items.name: Pushpaka Vimanam
items.overview: Pushpak finds a way to travel through time. He makes one change in the past, which puts everything in his present at risk.

items.name: The Killing of The Golden Rooster
items.original_name: Valentín: La muerte del Gallo de Oro
items.overview: Twenty years after the murder of the Mexican regional music icon, the production reconstructs the hours that shaped his story and revisits the questions that, two decades later, remain unanswered.

items.name: Rise of the Underdog
items.overview: After imprisonment and his family's downfall in his previous life, Ma Dawei returns to a pivotal moment in the past, determined to avoid old traps, seize new opportunities, and protect his loved ones.

items.name: The Killing of the Golden Rooster
items.original_name: The Killing of the Golden Rooster
items.overview: A three-part HBO original true-crime documentary series that explores the life, legacy, and mysterious 2006 murder of Mexican regional music icon Valentín Elizalde.

items.name: The Jigsaw Puzzle Murder
items.overview: When a dismembered torso is discovered in woodland on the edge of Salford, detectives launch a murder investigation with no DNA match, witnesses or obvious suspects. As a national media storm unfolds, forensic clues, new suspects and further discoveries across Greater Manchester begin to reveal the shocking truth behind the killing

items.name: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal
items.original_name: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal
items.overview: Follows former Miss USA and Miss Universe contestants, insiders and whistleblowers exposing misconduct rigging and NDAs behind the pageant, including a contestant walkout and judge resignation at the 2025 Miss Universe finals in Thailand.

items.name: The New Hire Is Too Hot to Handle
Cunk on Cinema
items.overview: Philomena Cunk asks experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to the entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

items.name: Omerta
items.overview: The series delves into the life of the prominent and influential Van Loo family, where behind their perfect image and luxurious lifestyle lies a web of secrets that must remain hidden at all costs.

items.name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
items.original_name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
items.overview: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.
